contentText: In the run up to the summit in Nairobi, Mark Owen is pleased to welcome Éléonore Caroit, France’s Deputy Minister for Francophonie, International Partnerships, and French Citizens Abroad. Paris seeks to expand and transform its relationship with the entire African continent, explains Ms. Carrot. Africa Forward, France's first summit in English-speaking Africa, is reflective of France’s new initiatives that are "not limited to former colonies” but rather “a forward-looking relationship that is based on youth, and based on growth.”
